attribution: Original fastText/lid.176: Armand Joulin, Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Tomas Mikolov and collaborators, Meta/Facebook Research. ONNX conversion: Tigre Gotico Lda. Weights retain CC-BY-SA-3.0 independently of crawlx source licensing.
trainingData: Upstream reports Wikipedia, Tatoeba and SETimes under CC-BY-SA. This is upstream provenance, not an independently audited training corpus.
conversion: Pinned model card reports direct re-export, no retraining; graph Gather/ReduceMean/MatMul/Sigmoid, with external UTF-8 signed-byte FNV-1a n-grams and Huffman path combination. No conversion-repository Python source is copied into runtime.
validation: Downloaded files SHA-256 checked against the immutable Hugging Face LFS graph digest and locally computed auxiliary digests. No inference, parity, held-out quality or 176-language support gate was run by this implementation owner.
